about_the_game:
This asset collection was created under the unique constraint of using only the "9-bit color" 512-color palette, reminiscent of classic 16-bit home gaming systems. All color arrangements are limited to palettes of 15 colors each, ensuring a retro aesthetic.

■192 Walking and Face Graphics Designed for Playable Characters

The collection includes 48 unique characters, each with four variations, resulting in a total of 192 patterns.
These variations range from simple color swaps to different clothing designs and skin tone adjustments.

Contents for RPG Maker MZ/MV:

  • Characters: 30 sheets

  • Faces: 24 sheets

------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
